cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Then we'll have a look at the equipment and you can try making a pot of your own.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Like many people, I'm sure you know that pottery as an art form is tens of thousands of

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: years old. And we know this because it stands the test of time.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Things like baskets and pictures don't survive in the earth in the same way that pots do.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: and even if ancient pots are found in small pieces they still provide a lot of

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: information about the past.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: There no doubt that pottery has given archaeologists a fascinating insight into how

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: ancient hls lived The shape of an artefact may have been lost but archaeologists can tell

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: whether the pots were for, say, storage or cooking by examining the impressions on the

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: clay, the scratches from tools, and the clay itself can reveal where the pots came from.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: When I ask people why they want to take a pottery class with me, they sometimes talk

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: about these things.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Like our ancestors, they hope that something they create will also last longer than they

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: do, that their work, whether it is good or not, might say something about humanity many

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: years after their death. Of course, you will all have your own reasons for coming here.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: As far as I'm concerned, what I love most is the concentration you need to make a good

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: pot. That focus takes you away from the stresses of everyday life.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: If you're elderly, it's also good exercise for hands and wrists and helps with arthritis.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: And of course, it's a fun activity for children because it's so messy.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Here at Edelman Pottery, we show you some of the basic pottery techniques so that you can

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: use these to create whatever you wish. A gift for a friend, perhaps.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Like nearly everyone who comes here, I'm sure this is the first time you will have tried

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: the art So we'll keep things simple today Now, before we move on, can I just say a word

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: about what you're wearing?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: As we said in our email please remove any watches necklaces etc and put them somewhere

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: safe If you have long hair do tie it back now We provide aprons later but I trust your

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: clothes are old but comfortable not your favourite T-shirt or jeans.
